description: This file defines API routes for managing test scripts in a web application, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting test scripts, using FastAPI. It also handles authentication, database interactions, and logging audit events.

classes.name: StandardResponse
classes.description: A dictionary subclass representing standard API responses.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A dictionary subclass for paginated list responses.

methods.name: create_test_script( script_data: TestScriptCreate, request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new test script, including logging audit events.

methods.name: list_test_scripts( page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all test scripts with pagination.

methods.name: get_test_script( test_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific test script by ID.

methods.name: update_test_script( test_id: str, script_data: TestScriptUpdate, request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing test script, including logging audit events.

methods.name: delete_test_script( test_id: str, request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove (soft delete) a test script, with audit logging.
